name: Oway
long_description:
America is operating at half of its potential industrial supply chain efficiency, with 50% of all the truck space being left empty due to foundational issues with how the logistics industry historically works. This issue directly makes everything made and sold in America more expensive and less competitive against global competitors. 

Oway is building a new vertical in the industrial supply chain by indexing live unused truck space and make it usable via API - a transparent infrastructure layer that simply by existing boosts the productivity and market caps of the businesses that plug into it. For the broad economy, this means freight costs that are up to 50% lower than what was previously possible, touchpoints are reduced, damage rates are significantly lowered, and inventory float is minimized via new JIT capabilities. For carriers, Oway’s integration can increase annual revenues by up to 30% with minimal impact to their existing business. They simply earn more by monetizing space that would have gone unused.

Our mission is to transform empty truck space into an asset that strengthens U.S. competitiveness. By lowering the cost of goods sold, we help businesses grow. By improving carrier margins, we make trucking more sustainable. And creating a live index of the supply chain, we are laying the foundation for a resilient, transparent industrial layer that can support America’s reindustrialization in the decades ahead.
one_liner: Turning America’s supply chain inefficiency into infrastructure.
